from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BasicEpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """A basic earnings per share record extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name found in the filing header")
    eps_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Basic Earnings Per Share', 'Basic Net Loss Per Share')")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The EPS amount as reported; losses should be negative")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    basic_eps_records: list[BasicEpsRecord]
